name: Pigmentation-focused MITF-M melanocyte program
rationale: All members are MITF-M-driven melanocyte functions (pigment synthesis, granule localization, melanocyte differentiation, light response); unlike the confusables it covers melanin synthesis and light response but lacks MITF-M cell-cycle, DNA-repair and MITF-M regulation members.

name: Epithelial salt-water homeostasis via chloride transport
rationale: Members cover renal/epithelial Na, K, Cl and water handling and osmotic responses; cation-chloride cotransporter, SLC26A3 and transepithelial chloride members distinguish it from confusables centred on P-type ATPases/aldosterone, Na/H exchangers or K2P channels.

qualifier: from ER insertion to COPII export
name: Early secretory trafficking from ER insertion to COPII export
rationale: Members span SRP and tail-anchored/multi-pass insertion into the ER and COPII cargo loading for ER-to-Golgi transport; confusables instead emphasise ER folding/ERAD and COPI or lack the COPII arm.

name: SR calcium handling favoring cytosolic calcium clearance
rationale: Members regulate SR/ER calcium uptake via ATPase transporters, sequestration, Na/Ca exchange and restrained ryanodine-receptor release; confusables lean towards cardiac contraction or positive calcium release.

name: Erythroid differentiation under transcriptional control
rationale: Members describe erythroid differentiation and its transcriptional drivers (TAL1-GFI1B, stress-activated ATF signalling, terminal erythroid programmes); confusables add stem-cell/primitive-definitive hematopoiesis or megakaryocyte development.

name: Urea cycle arginine synthesis via OTC
rationale: Members are urea cycle citrulline and arginine synthesis plus ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency variants; confusables include ammonium/ornithine regulation or other urea cycle enzyme deficiencies but not OTC.

name: Antimicrobial protein killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members are host killing of microbes (antifungal humoral response, Gram-positive defense, cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity); confusables centre on respiratory burst, degranulation or mucosal iron assimilation.

name: Glucose provision from glycogen and dietary sugars
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases together with intestinal sugar digestion and hexose transport; confusables cover glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, galactose catabolism or urate transport instead.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signalling in tumour suppression
rationale: Members are TGF-beta/BMP/activin/AMH receptor-SMAD signalling and its regulation; RUNX3 tumour-suppressor targets and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants distinguish it from confusables lacking them.

core: T and B cell antigen-receptor signalling
name: T and B cell receptor signalling tuned by co-receptors
rationale: Members are TCR and BCR signalling with CD28, CTLA4, BTLA, CD22 and PECAM1 co-signals; confusables are T-cell-only activation signatures or lack the co-inhibitory/PECAM1 members.

name: Epithelial solute-carrier transport, chiefly amino acids and peptides
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC transport of amino acids, oligopeptides and urate with their renal/intestinal transport disorders; confusables centre on organic cations, hexoses or cationic amino acids.

name: Vascular growth and remodelling with smooth muscle switching
rationale: Members are VEGF/Tie-driven sprouting and lymphatic angiogenesis plus vascular smooth muscle differentiation, migration and phenotypic switching; the smooth muscle arm separates it from its closest confusable and the VEGF/Tie arm from the leukocyte-adhesion confusables.

name: Amino acid metabolism featuring tyrosine and proline catabolism
rationale: Members are alpha-amino acid synthesis and catabolism (tyrosine, phenylalanine, proline, glycine, glyoxylate); tyrosine catabolism distinguishes it from threonine/organic-acid confusables and proline/glycine from the phenylalanine confusable.

name: Wnt-regulated osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal progenitor commitment to and proliferation of osteoblasts via RUNX2, Wnt, BMP and mechanical load; confusables emphasise chondrocytes, osteoclasts or collagen/mineralization.

name: B cell development and activation via BCR signalling
rationale: Members cover B cell development, homeostasis, proliferation and BCR signalling cascades (BTK, RAS, CD22); confusables are B/plasma cell surface signatures or T cell programmes.

name: MECP2-mediated repression of neuronal gene expression
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation, its Rett loss-of-function variants, HDAC and translational repression and Rett-affected sensory behaviours; confusables are neurobehavioural terms lacking the MECP2 regulatory members.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription cycle with termination control
rationale: Members regulate Pol II initiation, elongation braking, termination and R-loop processing; termination/R-loop members distinguish it from elongation-complex and RNA-processing confusables.

name: SR calcium release control dampening cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-sensitive SR calcium release, cytosolic calcium reduction and cardiac membrane potential, with negative heart rate/contraction; confusables emphasise SERCA reuptake or positive force and rate.

name: p53-driven mitochondrial apoptosis via BH3-only proteins
rationale: Members are p53 transcriptional induction of death genes and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only inactivation of BCL-2 leading to cytochrome c release; confusables lack either the p53 transcription or the BH3-only arm.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members span follicle development, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and estrous cycle; confusables centre on gonadotropin secretion and response.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport, Hartnup-type
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane amino acid carriers (SLC6A19, SLC6A14, SLC1A1, proton-coupled) and their disorders; Hartnup and tryptophan members plus SLC1A1/SLC6A14 separate it from imino-glycinuria, cystinuria and peptide-transport confusables.

name: Centrosome-anchored microtubules for spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover MTOC nucleation/anchoring, centrosome positioning and astral microtubules orienting the spindle; confusables centre on centrosome maturation, centriole duplication or cytokinesis.

name: Cell-surface protein traffic via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis, endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling and constitutive secretion; confusables centre on Golgi-endosome-lysosome retrograde traffic or Rab/Arf GTPase control.

name: Cardiac muscle growth and contractility control
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, adaptation, regeneration and contraction/rate; positive contraction and rate distinguish it from the calcineurin hypertrophy confusable, cardiac identity from smooth muscle confusables.

name: Golgi and endosome membrane shape remodelling
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly, positioning and membrane tubulation; confusables centre on Golgi cargo traffic and COPI transport.

name: Repair of damaged DNA bases, including alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair (glycosylase defects, long-patch and single-nucleotide gap filling) plus ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal; confusables add mismatch or crosslink repair and lack the reversal arm.

name: Rho GTPase cycles of RhoA subfamily and Cdc42
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C, RHOD, RHOG, RHOJ and CDC42 with formin activation; confusables cover Rac, Rnd and atypical Rho GTPases.

name: Heme-derived bilirubin conjugation and hepatic clearance
rationale: Members are heme degradation, hepatic organic anion uptake, UGT1A conjugation and ABCC2 export with their hyperbilirubinemias; confusables are drug/xenobiotic ADME.

name: Imino acid and glycine transport defects
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 variants causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria; confusables are broader amino acid, hexose or urate transport.

name: Cerebellar and striatal motor coordination
rationale: Members are locomotion, reflexes, motor learning, proprioception and cerebellar/striatal development; confusables centre on vocal, social and sensory behaviours or MECP2.
